return rows

  .map((row, index) => ({
    json: {
      Id: row.Id,
      company_name: String(row.company_name).trim(),
      url_picked: String(row.url_picked || '').trim(),
      status: 'pending',
      attempt_count: String(row.attempt_count || '').trim() || '0',
      run_id: String(row.run_id || '').trim(),
      processing_started_at: String(row.processing_started_at || '').trim(),

      last_attempted_at: String(row.last_attempted_at || '').trim(),
      status_reason: String(row.status_reason || '').trim(),

      CreatedAt: String(row.CreatedAt || '').trim(),

    },
    pairedItem: { item: index }
  }));
